summary: No-ship. Re-verification: r1-1 resolved by the runtime-decoded Change/Noop/Refusal union and malformed-plan rejection (84-89, 179-180); r1-2 still open because the discriminated target is not carried across the unchanged run-bump-plan→ensure-bump-pr CLI boundary (91-108); r1-3 resolved by independent domains, explicit output policy, ordered floors, and regression cases (27-35, 181-182); r1-4 resolved within design.md by limiting readLedger to loading/shape/schema validation (36-42), but that fix introduced a conflicting ownership definition in CONTEXT.md. The fixes therefore leave two high-risk architecture defects.

facts.relaunchTail: This is a property of the run, not of the repository, so the round's next launch may use another backend (--reviewer claude) — the caller performs that switch as its second launch; this launcher never spawns a second backend itself.

triage: review-gate SKILL.md §§ Triage and Rounds govern. Render EVERY finding as a full table row — `ID | Finding (title + full body) | Severity | file:line | Code | Recommendation | Proposed decision` — never truncated and never inside a dialog; then ask the ROUND before the rows — take every Proposed decision as it stands, or decide row by row — and `as proposed` ends the round in that ONE action; only if row-by-row was chosen, ask per finding with that row's Proposed decision as the first option, a reject or defer taking a free-text reason; echo back ONLY the rows that carried free text, and none if the round was decided by selection alone. Max 2 rounds. Append the decided rows to `docs/reviews/<slug>/decisions.md` under a `### <gate> r<n> (<reviewer>)` heading — one line per row, `<ID> <decision> — <finding title>[; <reason for reject/defer>]`, and an accepted waiver as `WAIVED by user: <reason>` — then COMMIT it with this artifact. That grammar is not decoration: the conductors anchor on `^### <gate> r<n>` and read the waiver line as the pass condition, so a ledger written in any other shape reads back as a gate still owed.

findings.title: The discriminated target is lost before the mutation boundary
findings.body: The design requires branch naming and lane resolution to receive `{kind, name}`, but it does not carry that identity through the CLI boundary between the listed callsites. The current runner invokes ensure-bump-pr with only `--app` (`tools/run-bump-plan.ts:139`), while ensure-bump-pr accepts only that unqualified name (`tools/ensure-bump-pr.ts:250`). The design nevertheless says the existing argv-level tests survive and defines no replacement argument or decoding contract. Implemented literally, ensure-bump-pr cannot distinguish same-named app and bespoke targets when recomputing branches, validating commit ownership, or reconciling authorization. Guessing from filesystem policy sources recreates the original ambiguity and can overwrite or auto-arm the wrong PR.
findings.code:
target은 **판별 신원** `{kind: "app" | "bespoke", name}`(design r1-2) — apps 레인
(`.bindings.json`)과 베스포크 레인(`.image-pin.json`)은 인가 소스가 다르므로, kind 없는
이름은 동명 충돌 시 다른 target의 autoDeploy 정책을 적용하거나(승인 요구 PR을 자동
arm 포함) 브랜치를 공유해 PR을 덮어쓸 수 있다. `branchFor(target, tag)` +
`commitMessage(target, tag)` + `WRITER_IDENT` + `resolveLane(root, target)`(현행
`planApp`/`probeLane`의 **유일 구현**)이 전부 target 신원을 받는다.

**흡수하는 중복**: plan.json 계약 3벌 독립 선언(poll-ghcr:96 `Plan` ·
run-bump-plan:61 `PlanItem` — optionality 상이 · ensure-bump-pr:232 `LANES`),
명명 계약 6개의 생산자↔검증자 복제(브랜치 run-bump-plan:101↔ensure-bump-pr:326 ·
커밋 문구 :127↔:499 · writer 신원 :30↔:220,485,502), 그리고 ensure-bump-pr:1224의
**복붙-주석 seam**(poll-ghcr 소스를 주석으로 붙여넣어 동기화하던 것) 제거.

**이동 콜사이트**: poll-ghcr.ts · run-bump-plan.ts · ensure-bump-pr.ts · bump-tag.ts.
`action` 오타·미지 값은 `decodePlan()`의 런타임 red — 컴파일 red(TS)와 이중이다.

**살아남는 테스트**: test_ensure-bump-pr.bats 118건은 argv 인터페이스 경유라 생존.
계약 module 단위 bats 신설(명명 왕복: 생산 문자열을 검증 함수가 수용).
findings.recommendation: Define an explicit target-bearing CLI contract—such as `--kind app|bespoke --name <name>`—and fail closed when either part is absent. Make the shared module own both branch encoding and inverse decoding, migrate legacy unqualified refs safely, and add an end-to-end same-name app/bespoke test through runner, ensure-bump-pr, and reconcile-only.

findings.title: The narrowed ledger ownership contradicts the new domain SSOT
findings.body: The design correctly narrows readLedger and leaves bilateral reconciliation at each callsite, but the same working-tree change defines the policy-ledger domain in `CONTEXT.md:54-56` as having `tools/lib/policy-ledger.ts` own that reconciliation. These are mutually exclusive architectural authorities. Following CONTEXT.md recreates r1-4 behind an interface with no observed-domain input; following design.md leaves the repository's domain SSOT false. Because these reconciliations prevent undeclared and dead policy entries from producing false-green guards, this ambiguity can recreate the exact unsafe implementation the accepted fix was meant to exclude.
findings.code:
- `tools/lib/policy-ledger.ts`: `readLedger({path, container, entrySchema})` —
  **축소 범위**(design r1-4): fail-closed 로딩(빈 원장 = red) + 컨테이너 shape 통일
  (현행 4가지 → 1가지, 주석 키 `_readme`/`$comment` 통일) + `schema-check.ts` 재사용
  항목 검증**까지만** 소유. **미선언·죽은-선언 양방향 대조는 콜사이트에 남긴다** —
  소비자 3곳의 대조 의미론이 실질적으로 다르다(중첩 워크플로/job 신원 · CI-step
  커버리지 규칙 · 이미지 wildcard/면제 매칭). 공통 대조 interface는 공통형이 실증될
  때 추출한다(adapter 하나 = 가설 seam).
findings.recommendation: Update CONTEXT.md before ticketing so the policy-ledger definition assigns only fail-closed loading, container shape, and entry validation to readLedger, and explicitly assigns domain reconciliation to callsites until a real common interface exists.

next_steps: Carry the full target identity through every planner, runner, mutation, branch-decoding, and reconciliation boundary.
Align the policy-ledger domain definition with the accepted narrowed ownership, then rerun the design gate.
